name: Everllence
description: Volkswagen Group engine OEM in Augsburg, renamed from MAN Energy Solutions in June 2025. It offers modularised engine power plants with more than 32 GW installed since 1985, from sub-2.5-minute-start balancing plants to 200 MW+ baseload, and engines for power barges.

products: engines for power barges (MAN DT 18V48/60TS barge design)
